hooks.name: Project rules check
hooks.description: After saving app.py or a file under whose/, check for emojis in user-facing text, hardcoded secrets, and AI calls outside form submit handlers.

action.prompt: Check the file that was just saved for three things: any emoji in user-facing text, any hardcoded API key or passcode (reads from st.secrets or environment variables are fine), and any call to functions in whose/ai.py made outside a form submit handler. If you find a problem, report it in one or two sentences with the line and the fix. If the file is clean, say nothing.
